lines.zh: 我的脚没有碰地，一直悬着。
lines.en: My feet never touch the ground. They hang.

lines.zh: 绳子在我身后拖着，很长。
lines.en: The rope drags behind me. Very long.

lines.zh: 我晃过来的时候，空气会冷。
lines.en: The air cools as I swing past.
Each step is like a pendulum.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走，脖子不听话。
lines.en: I walk with my head tilted. My neck won't obey.
The rope pulls taut. I stop.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪，发出木头声。
lines.en: I shift slowly, creaking like wood.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都弯下去。
lines.en: The grass bends where I pass.

lines.zh: 我悬着往前，像挂在风里。
lines.en: I move forward suspended, as if hung on the wind.
I head toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我晃得不高，扫过腰的高度。
lines.en: My swing is low, at waist height.
I turn a full circle. My face points at you.
I hang there, turning slowly.
There's a deep mark on my neck.
I do nothing. I only sway.

lines.zh: 绳子多长，我的范围就多大。
lines.en: As long as the rope, that's my reach.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾朝着地面，够不到。
lines.en: My toes point down and never reach.
The night is quiet but for the rope.
I'm listening for someone breathing.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上晃来晃去。
lines.en: My shadow swings back and forth on the ground.
My ribcage could serve as a cage.
My lids are half lowered, yet I see.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，又垂下去。
lines.en: I lift a hand and let it fall.
I'm used to hanging like this.

lines.zh: 有风吹过，我晃得更厉害。
lines.en: The wind blows and I swing harder.

lines.zh: 我在等有人走到我下面。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to walk beneath me.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我的脸已经更低。
lines.en: As you look up, my face is already lower.
I'm above you, turning slowly.
Don't stand in the rope's shadow.
My face is turned down. Watching you.
I've been looking at your neck for a while.

lines.zh: 绳子这么长，你跑不出去。
lines.en: The rope is long. You won't get out of range.
I'm in no hurry. I'm always up here.

lines.zh: 你看我，我的头就歪得更厉害。
lines.en: When you look at me, my head tilts further.

lines.zh: 这么近，你闻得到绳子的味。
lines.en: This close, you can smell the rope.

lines.zh: 我垂着手，你没发现手在动。
lines.en: My hands hang low. You didn't notice they move.
I'm coming down.
Not falling. Descending.
You step back. I turn with you.
I see your throat move.
You speak. I don't answer.
I've memorized that face.
Stay a moment more. Just a moment.

lines.zh: 我的脚不沾地，追你不用跑。
lines.en: My feet don't touch the ground; I don't run to follow.

lines.zh: 我的脚离地，比你想的近。
lines.en: My feet are closer to the ground than you think.

lines.zh: 你停住的那一瞬，我弯下腰。
lines.en: The instant you stop, I bend down.
I sway and the rope creaks.

lines.zh: 我不会流血，只会晃得更厉害。
lines.en: I don't bleed. I just swing harder.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打转了半圈。
lines.en: That spun me half a turn.
My head hangs, then lifts slowly.
Look. I'm still here.

lines.zh: 绳子缠住我自己的腿了。
lines.en: The rope has wound round my own leg.

lines.zh: 疼这个词，我很久没用过。
lines.en: The word pain — I haven't used it in a while.
I withdraw and hang higher.
Don't rush. I can't die.
That one goes on your account.
I can't eat anything.

lines.zh: 你举着它，站在绳子下面。
lines.en: You hold it up, standing under the rope.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我却看着绳子。
lines.en: You raise the bread, but I watch the rope.
The higher you hold it, the closer I come.
My hand hangs down and touches it.
I can't keep hold of it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想让你站着。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. I only want you to keep standing.
Set it down, then step back.
When you bend, your head is exposed.
Thank you. You needn't hold it up.
You walked into my rope.
I swung over and touched your shoulder.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，绳子会绕住你。
lines.en: One bump and the rope winds around you.
My body is light, and very cold.
When you retreat, the rope follows.
Don't touch my feet.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: We brushed and you shivered.
I turn and the rope draws tight.

lines.zh: 你被缠了一下，很快解开。
lines.en: You got tangled briefly, then freed yourself.
Stand well back. The rope winds.
What is left for something like me.
Looking up at me is company enough.
I can't reach you.
The rope is only so long.

lines.zh: 你站在下面，我就低头看。
lines.en: You stand below and I look down.
Hanging here counts as being together.
Don't untie that rope.
I fear touching ground. Badly.
Just stand there. Don't move.
Dawn is near. You should go.
I let a hand down. Can't reach.
I'll swing over to you.
Now it's hanging on the rope.
I caught it with my toes. It fell.
I don't pick up what's on the ground.
I take it, then let go.

lines.zh: 我从绳上垂手，够了个空。
lines.en: I dangle a hand from the rope and close on air.
Take it. I won't block you.

lines.zh: 你低头的时候，我就在上面。
lines.en: While you bow your head, I'm above.
Take it. Don't come under me again.
Someone's come into this ground.
I turn my face toward it, slowly.
The rope just reaches that far.
I don't shout, and I don't hurry.
My feet begin to lower.

lines.zh: 你听见木头一样的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that creaking?
The shadow at your feet changed.
Looking up won't help now.
I'm directly above your head.
From this beam, downward.
I'm coming down from above.

lines.zh: 你越跑，绳子越先到拐角。
lines.en: The more you run, the sooner my rope reaches the corner.

lines.zh: 这块屋檐，我吊了很多年。
lines.en: I have hung under this eave for years.
The rope is at your feet.
You stepped on the rope's end.

lines.zh: 你的脚一动，绳梢就抬了。
lines.en: Your foot moves and the rope tip lifts.
My rope grinds against the beam.

lines.zh: 我吊在上面，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: I hang above. The wind makes me sway.
The end of the rope isn't far from you.
I don't need to look. I can hear.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，绳子晃得越慢。
lines.en: The faster you pant, the slower my rope swings.
I'm counting your steps.

lines.zh: 墙边没有钩子，你躲不上去。
lines.en: No hooks on that wall; you can't climb out of reach.
I lower a hand and reach slowly.
Behind you is nothing.

lines.zh: 我借着风晃过去，脚尖拖地。
lines.en: I swing on the wind, toes dragging the floor.
Back and forth — you'll tire eventually.
My feet are an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 你听见绳子绷紧的声音了。
lines.en: You heard the rope creak tight.
My head tilts to the other side.
You dodge well. I still see you.
But the rope covers more ground than you.
Keep retreating and you'll hit the end.
I'm smiling. You can't see it.
The rope nearly reaches.
You're standing in exactly the right spot.
My hand comes down and takes your shoulder.
The rope swings round and loops you.
I don't pull. I only tighten a little.
My foot touches you. Very cold.
I come down with my whole weight.

lines.zh: 你被吊起来了，离地一寸。
lines.en: You're lifted an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 绳结贴着你的颈侧，别挣。
lines.en: The knot rests by your neck; don't struggle.
My face comes close to yours.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边，什么也没说。
lines.en: I'm at your ear. I say nothing.

lines.zh: 我的心早停了，只听见你的。
lines.en: My heart stopped long ago; I hear only yours.

lines.zh: 我用绳子碰你，轻得像灰。
lines.en: I touch you with the rope, light as ash.
I loosen a little so you can breathe.
Don't thank me. I'll tighten again.
The rope runs smooth in my hand.

lines.zh: 吊着的人，看得见你的眼睛。
lines.en: The hanged man can see your eyes.
Like this. Stop struggling.

lines.zh: 我先出现的是那根绳子。
lines.en: The rope appears first.

lines.zh: 然后是我的脚，悬在离地一指。
lines.en: Then my feet, an inch off the ground.
I swing slowly out of the dark.
My rope hangs from this tree.
The mark on my neck is deep.

lines.zh: 我转过头，骨头响了一下。
lines.en: I turn my head and a bone clicks.
You can't see my face at night.
I'm waiting for someone to look up.

lines.zh: 绳子拖过地面，声音很轻。
lines.en: The rope drags the ground, softly.
I swing twice and stop.
The air around has gone cold.
I don't need to walk.

lines.zh: 你听见木头响，就是我在动。
lines.en: If you hear creaking, I'm moving.
I hang here. I've always hung here.

lines.zh: 这个位置，是我自己选的。
lines.en: This spot I chose myself.
It's empty below. Good.

lines.zh: 绳扣先转，我的脸才跟上。
lines.en: The noose turns first; my face follows.
You came. I waited long.
Then don't leave. Stay here.
My ribs are woven into a cage.

lines.zh: 绳子烧起来了，我一动不动。
lines.en: The rope catches fire. I don't move.
The rope snapped and I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我倒熟悉这个。
lines.en: Water over my head. I know this feeling.
The blast set me swinging.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肋笼，卡在两根骨间。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my rib cage and sticks between two bones.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我显出了原样。
lines.en: That light showed what I really am.
One who hangs has long forgotten hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，绳子焦了一段。
lines.en: Lightning struck; part of the rope is charred.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以挂的地方。
lines.en: There's nothing to hang from here.
